“Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth…

translations.web: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;
translations.bsb: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
